scope: HR1280x768 FP16 engine / FP32 IO, G1 v1-motion/2; current implementation authoritative over historical PCR design prose

objects.name: Compressed JPEG and frame metadata
objects.location: CPU file/source and owned pinned staging
objects.dtype_shape: variable-length uint8 JPEG bytes; FrameId=int64 processing index, Epoch=uint64
objects.payload: compressed byte count varies; default max_jpeg_bytes=16 MiB
objects.lifetime: enqueue owns a copy before return; staging reuse follows preprocessor completion; FrameId is zero-based contiguous, independent of source image IDs/PTS

objects.name: Original-resolution planar RGB8
objects.producer: nvJPEG hardware backend plus color conversion, or device-video conversion / explicit host-RGB input mode
objects.consumer: F02 model resize; F05 flow grayscale
objects.lifetime: borrowed; before next decode/overwrite host waits rgb_read_done recorded on D after F05, because nvJPEG uses private streams

objects.name: Model images tensor
objects.dtype_shape: FP32 NCHW [1,3,768,1280] for explicitly selected HR profile
objects.producer: F02 normalize /255 and antialiased bilinear stretch resize
objects.lifetime: single fixed model input reused in D order; F03 enqueue precedes next F02 write; Graph binds fixed address

objects.name: Six raw tensors and producer outcome
objects.dtype_shape: FP32 cls_p3/p4/p5 [1,80,96,160]/[1,80,48,80]/[1,80,24,40], reg counterparts replace 80 by 4; 9 ScanStatus objects each 2 uint32
objects.producer: F03 TensorRT and selective scan plugins; model_producer_cuda aggregate finite checks / plugin flags
objects.lifetime: fixed D-local raw outputs/scratch reused in D stream order; aggregate producer status must precede F04; FP16 engine tactics do not imply FP16 I/O or scan state

objects.name: DetectionCandidates candidate slot CS
objects.dtype_shape: 64-byte header + up to 300 rows of 32 bytes; each row FP32 xyxy/score, uint32 class_id/candidate_id/flags
objects.producer: F04 decode -> global all-class Top-300 -> person filter -> NMS; rows retain kept/suppressed classification
objects.consumer: M candidate identity checks; current mask; F04b
objects.lifetime: D waits consumed before slot reuse and publishes ready; M waits ready. Graph path releases CS only after the entire M tail graph, not immediately after F04b

objects.name: Motion image MI
objects.location: GPU pitched NVOF-owned GRAYSCALE8 ring; default 2 slots
objects.allocation_bytes: pitch*height determined by NVOF; logical payload is not exact allocated bytes
objects.producer: F05 reads original planar RGB, independently from model images
objects.consumer: F06 NvOFExecute reference and flow_output current-gray delivery
objects.lifetime: D waits MI consumed then produces and records ready; M waits ready; M releases consumed only after final flow_output copy

objects.name: OFA output and reduced flow cells
objects.location: GPU NVOF buffers and M scratch
objects.dtype_shape: raw grid4 SHORT2 (2 int16, S10.5) [ceil(Hm/4),ceil(Wm/4)] with pitch; reduced cells float32(dx,dy) [floor(Hm/8),floor(Wm/8)]
objects.producer: host NvOFExecute submits fixed-function OFA work on M IO streams, then CUDA component-wise median of each 2x2 group of grid vectors
objects.consumer: component-wise global median after exclusion by previous committed person mask
objects.lifetime: private fixed OFA input/output and scratch are M-ordered; actual pitch/private SDK memory excluded from these logical bytes; no D2H dense-flow payload in JPEG tracking mainline

objects.name: MotionContext global translation
objects.location: GPU M output then pinned CPU result field
objects.dtype_shape: epoch/frame/reference_frame, MotionStatus, peak/pcr/confidence, FP32 tx/ty in original-image pixels
objects.producer: F06 masked global component-wise median; min 8 retained cells for valid estimate
objects.consumer: F08a GMC control/Kalman predict; per-frame output/flow record
objects.lifetime: M updates one motion context in order; copied to pinned host only after M tail, followed by packet copy and one done event; not ResultPacket wire ABI

objects.name: PredictedState and confirmed-track prior
objects.dtype_shape: DevicePredicted holds up to 512 DeviceTrack and 512 DevicePredictedPrior rows; FP32 8D state / 8x8 covariance and xyxy priors
objects.payload: native DevicePredicted ABI; no claim that its logical fields are a wire encoding
objects.producer: F08a reads last committed tracks plus motion, performs one GMC control and one Kalman predict for the active working slot
objects.lifetime: never independently committed; M-only reuse in frame order. Prior belongs to this frame after GMC and predict, not previous-frame boxes

objects.name: F04b DetectionBatch
objects.dtype_shape: DeviceBatch header and up to 300 rows, FP32 xyxy/observed_score/association_score, class/ID and can_continue/can_birth flags
objects.payload: native DeviceBatch ABI; fixed capacity 300, separate from ResultPacket capacity 256
objects.producer: F04b combines current candidates and current confirmed prior
objects.consumer: F07/F08b sparse association, update and lifecycle
objects.lifetime: M stage after candidate ready; continuation-only suppressed rows may not birth; output rows sorted by candidate_id for deterministic downstream traversal

objects.name: Committed/working TrackState, gray, mask and Control
objects.dtype_shape: two TrackState capacities of 512 tracks (DeviceTrack 424 B); gray uint8 [2,Hm,Wm]; mask uint8 [2,floor(Hm/8),floor(Wm/8)]; common Control committed_slot/working_slot
objects.producer: flow_output writes current gray working version; flow_mask writes current kept-person mask working version; F08b writes next tracks working version
objects.consumer: next committed frame F06 uses gray/mask; F08a uses committed tracks
objects.lifetime: begin selects working_slot=1-committed_slot; only successful commit flips shared slot/frame, logically publishing all three together. Failed partial working state is not published; no full-state rollback copy required

objects.name: ResultPacket and owned host result
objects.location: one GPU packet buffer, pinned CPU ring (default 4), then caller-owned copied result
objects.dtype_shape: canonical little-endian packet: 80-byte header, capacity 256, 48-byte rows; count/status/identity and unused bytes explicitly encoded
objects.producer: M graph packet encoder after commit; then two ordered D2H copies on M
objects.consumer: receive waits done, copies bytes/decodes/validates epoch-frame, CPU SequenceOutput or stream output
objects.lifetime: pinned host slot retained until receive; full ring throws recoverable receive-first before enqueue. Device packet can be one allocation because M ordering serializes packet(k+1) after D2H(k)
objects.current_row_selection: cuda tracking emits confirmed tracks with age==0 only, flags=1 observed. With default measurement_box=false, xyxy comes from filtered Kalman state; enabling measurement_box changes emitted coordinates to last matched measurement only, not association decisions.

thresholds.rule: global all-class Top-300 first, then person class0; NMS suppresses only if IoU > 0.5; kept and suppressed rows preserved; inverse stretch mapping to original xyxy, no clipping
kept score >= 0.05 enters batch with can_birth=true (new track birth still requires observed_score >= 0.28 and other lifecycle rules)
score >= 0.10, IoU with this-frame confirmed predicted prior >= 0.30, dedup IoU > 0.70 rejected, max 50 accepted; can_birth=false; association_score=min(observed_score,0.28)

current kept class0 boxes with score >= 0.45; cell center x/y must lie in half-open [x1,x2),[y1,y2). Writes working mask now; next successful frame uses it via committed_slot. Global reduction excludes prior committed mask, not current mask; missed/low-score people can remain.
SLOW, grid4, cell8, min 8 unmasked cells; componentwise medians, translation-only in original pixels, no fusion with old PCR

JPEG_sequence.rules: SequenceOutput.add consumes every supplied ResultPacket row (does not filter observed flag); frame=MOT processing index+1, output_id mapped by first appearance to dense per-sequence IDs. finish() requires no failure and fills gaps only for IDs with >=5 supplied rows, <=35 missing frames, conf=-1; output sorted frame/id and written at EOF.

stream.rules: track_stream defaults HR, GPU device-video/NVDEC, result_slots=1, immediate enqueue/receive cadence, native IDs, no EOF interpolation/global renumber. Explicit CPU decode path is separate. PTS does not make fixed-step Kalman variable-dt.

limits: Current code is exactly the pinned base for the listed 25 files. Report rendering is not a new runtime/model/GPU experiment or formal acceptance.
FP16 engine tactics do not turn all tensors, scan plugins or tracker state into FP16. Input and six raw outputs are FP32.
Frame-local T=1 spatial scan resets its state per call; no cross-frame Mamba hidden state. Cross-frame identities live in tracker/motion/control.
NVOFA is fixed-function GPU hardware with host NvOFExecute submission. CUDA trace bounds do not directly expose OFA engine busy/utilization.
G1 flow image comes from original RGB; no Hanning/PCR/cuFFT is in the current G1 path. motion.hpp still contains legacy motion/1 types and is shared, not proof of current FFT execution.
CUDA Graph includes only D(F03/producer/F04) and M tail(F04b/association/update/commit/packet). F01/F02/F05, G1, predict, mask, event handoffs and D2H are outside those graphs.
Working/committed dual state is distinct from MI/CS/result rings. Counts 2/2/4 are defaults and do not mean every API/CLI is HR or ring4.
Cross-frame work may overlap, but M(n+1) remains after M(n) commit/packet/D2H in a single consumer stream; stream/resource overlap is not race-free proof.

After failure custom compute is gated, but control/commit/packet and some library/scratch work may still run. First failure remains sticky, prior committed state remains valid, and already-submitted tails receive FAILED/SKIPPED status with zero rows.
Canonical ResultPacket 12368-byte wire encoding is different from native MotionContext 56-byte ABI and internal device struct ABIs; do not serialize native structs as interchangeable packets.
Logical tensor/row payload sizes exclude pitch padding, TensorRT workspace, intermediate activations, driver/nvJPEG/NVOF private allocations and cache; do not present their sum as total VRAM.
Full G1 memcheck, native full Graph racecheck and nvJPEG initcheck retain their existing OPEN/FAIL limits; a documentation audit does not close these gates.

The packet ABI permits observed/predicted flags, but the current CUDA tracker emits only confirmed tracks matched this frame (age==0, observed flag). Do not infer that lost/predicted rows are continuously emitted. Default coordinates are Kalman state boxes, not raw detector measurement boxes.

After failure, flow_context returns without writing when run_stage=false, so the reused MotionContext can retain an earlier frame. receive validates packet epoch/frame only. Interpret motion only after the enclosing ResultPacket is OK, then use MotionStatus validity; failed/skipped attached motion is not a newly validated estimate.

document_review.operation: Final read-only TEX and SVG semantic review against pinned implementation; visual inspection of flow and state SVGs
confirmed: Motion table orders committed gray/MI input, cells/median, MotionContext, working gray write and mi_consumed before predict/prior; current mask follows candidate availability
Control is one shared control object; TrackState, gray and mask each use paired payload versions with common committed/working slot
Predict writes separate DevicePredicted scratch; update writes working TrackState
D graph contains F03/producer/F04; M graph contains F04b/association-update/commit/packet; motion/predict/mask and D2H lie outside those graph boundaries
M(n+1) is ordered after prior M commit/packet/D2H, including failure paths; only successful commit advances the shared version
MI/CS ready and consumed, result receive-count lease, and separate RGB host-wait protection agree with implementation
Motion uses previous committed mask; current kept person score >=0.45 builds next working mask; no current-frame mask is retroactively used by preceding G1
FP32 IO/raw payloads are distinct from FP16 tactics; canonical packet bytes are distinct from native MotionContext ABI
Current output rows are confirmed age=0 observed; default measurement_box=false returns filtered Kalman state coordinates
Failed/skipped attached single-buffer MotionContext may be stale; packet status must be checked before interpreting motion
Session input mode is fixed by configuration; JPEG offline CPU interpolation/final write and stream native observed-output profiles retain distinct completion boundaries
Current G1, no temporal Mamba hidden state, fixed-function OFA visibility, historical trace scope, and open sanitizer boundaries are stated without new acceptance claims
